title: Proper monomorphisms of schemes are closed immersions
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then $f$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] if and only if it is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and a monomorphism (a left-cancellable morphism in the category of schemes).

proof.text: Apply Mathlib IsClosedImmersion.iff_isProper_and_mono, which states exactly the equivalence, with no additional hypotheses.
